paths.description: Homepage/community portal, primary entry and global chrome; represents board discovery and consent-on-load behavior.
Popular-content listing template; represents topic and index/feed pages.
Representative hot-deal article/detail page, including long media-rich content.
Account entry and sign-in form, representing authentication and form assistance.

findings.summary: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the page remains a white/light design; the root color-scheme is normal and body text remains rgb(0,0,0).
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the page remains a white/light design; the root color-scheme is normal and body text remains rgb(0,0,0).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light and dark schemes at the root and retint surfaces with system-driven color tokens.

findings.summary: Navigation and content changes are abrupt and no authored View Transition usage was detected in the rendered document.
findings.evidence: Navigation and content changes are abrupt and no authored View Transition usage was detected in the rendered document.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-document and cross-document navigation with View Transitions while preserving reduced-motion behavior.

findings.summary: The long listing uses static desktop chrome with no scroll progress, shrinking header, or other position-aware navigation cue.
findings.evidence: The long listing uses static desktop chrome with no scroll progress, shrinking header, or other position-aware navigation cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight, declarative scroll-state cue where it helps users orient within long feeds and articles.

findings.summary: A consent interstitial obscures the full primary viewport on every clean-session homepage, listing, and article capture before the user can read content.
findings.evidence: A consent interstitial obscures the full primary viewport on every clean-session homepage, listing, and article capture before the user can read content.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid blocking core content on load; present privacy choices in a compact, immediately dismissible and equally weighted interface.

findings.summary: The blocking consent experience exposes no native dialog element, while the host page contains zero dialog, popover, or details primitives.
findings.evidence: The blocking consent experience exposes no native dialog element, while the host page contains zero dialog, popover, or details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a correctly labelled modal dialog for blocking consent and native popover/details for transient disclosures, with focus containment and restoration.

findings.summary: The mobile-sized viewport is a scaled 1050px desktop interface with dense navigation, tiny metadata and extensive non-content chrome.
findings.evidence: The mobile-sized viewport is a scaled 1050px desktop interface with dense navigation, tiny metadata and extensive non-content chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Create a content-first narrow layout that collapses secondary navigation and increases content density only where legible.

findings.summary: At a 390px viewport the page has no viewport meta tag and Chrome renders a 1050px layout scaled to 0.
findings.evidence: At a 390px viewport the page has no viewport meta tag and Chrome renders a 1050px layout scaled to 0.371x; the same failure affects the article and login page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a width=device-width viewport declaration and replace fixed desktop sizing with intrinsic, fluid layouts that reflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Representative components remain fixed in the 1050px desktop layout on narrow screens; no container-query adaptation was observed.
findings.evidence: Representative components remain fixed in the 1050px desktop layout on narrow screens; no container-query adaptation was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Define reusable component containers and adapt cards, nav and article metadata using container queries with a safe base layout.

findings.summary: The probe found 105 of 207 visible interactive controls below 24px in at least one dimension, and the first focused link had outline-style none.
findings.evidence: The probe found 105 of 207 visible interactive controls below 24px in at least one dimension, and the first focused link had outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase touch targets to at least 24px with adequate spacing and provide a strong :focus-visible indicator independent of hover.

findings.summary: Lighthouse mobile measured LCP 3.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse mobile measured LCP 3.5s, outside the good <=2.5s range, although CLS was 0.022 and TBT 60ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce render-blocking CSS and defer nonessential ad/analytics scripts.

findings.summary: The HAR recorded 66 requests and 960KB transferred, including 16 parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets and multiple large third-party scripts.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 66 requests and 960KB transferred, including 16 parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets and multiple large third-party scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer noncritical styles and scripts, and verify cache policy and dependency depth.

findings.summary: Scripts account for 746KB of the 960KB transfer; AdSense and Google Tag Manager alone transfer about 355KB before user interaction.
findings.evidence: Scripts account for 746KB of the 960KB transfer; AdSense and Google Tag Manager alone transfer about 355KB before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Load advertising and analytics conditionally after consent and interaction, and remove unused legacy bundles.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found unlabeled inputs/selects, an untitled iframe and an unnamed link; the custom probe counted seven unlabeled controls and 58 empty links.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unlabeled inputs/selects, an untitled iframe and an unnamed link; the custom probe counted seven unlabeled controls and 58 empty links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control and frame an accessible name, associate labels programmatically, and remove empty interactive links.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reported 25 color-contrast failures, including header links and muted interface text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 25 color-contrast failures, including header links and muted interface text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use contrast-tested color tokens meeting WCAG AA in default and interactive states.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found invalid heading order and no main landmark; the focus probe reported outline-style none on the first focused link.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found invalid heading order and no main landmark; the focus probe reported outline-style none on the first focused link.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one logical heading hierarchy, explicit landmarks, DOM-order focus and visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: At a 390px viewport the entire desktop layout is scaled to 37%, making navigation, metadata and body text physically tiny.
findings.evidence: At a 390px viewport the entire desktop layout is scaled to 37%, making navigation, metadata and body text physically tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow at device width and establish readable minimum font sizes, line heights and measure.

findings.summary: There is no viewport meta tag, content does not reflow to 390px, and Lighthouse reports insufficient target size.
findings.evidence: There is no viewport meta tag, content does not reflow to 390px, and Lighthouse reports insufficient target size.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore user-scalable responsive viewport behavior, reflow without two-dimensional panning and enlarge touch targets.

findings.summary: The document has a valid HTML doctype and UTF-8 charset, but Lighthouse found two deprecated API warnings and the image audit found one 4x oversized logo plus legacy/lazy-loading gaps.
findings.evidence: The document has a valid HTML doctype and UTF-8 charset, but Lighthouse found two deprecated API warnings and the image audit found one 4x oversized logo plus legacy/lazy-loading gaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the valid document foundation, replace deprecated APIs and deliver correctly sized modern responsive images.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found deprecated Topics/unload usage, six BFCache failure reasons and DevTools inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found deprecated Topics/unload usage, six BFCache failure reasons and DevTools inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload handlers, address actionable BFCache blockers and migrate deprecated integrations.

findings.summary: The page lacks a viewport meta tag and Lighthouse found non-crawlable anchor controls using nohref/onclick.
findings.evidence: The page lacks a viewport meta tag and Lighthouse found non-crawlable anchor controls using nohref/onclick.
findings.suggestedFix: Add the responsive viewport declaration and use buttons for actions or real href links for navigation.

findings.summary: Canonical and robots metadata are present, but /sitemap.
findings.evidence: Canonical and robots metadata are present, but /sitemap.xml returns 404 and the default robots policy blocks most routes for generic crawlers.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap consistent with canonical public routes and document intentional crawler restrictions.

findings.summary: Open Graph metadata exists, but the representative deal/article has no JSON-LD describing its visible article/deal entity.
findings.evidence: Open Graph metadata exists, but the representative deal/article has no JSON-LD describing its visible article/deal entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD for article/deal content while keeping social metadata aligned with visible content.

findings.summary: HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but CSP is missing and all three observed cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but CSP is missing and all three observed cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive CSP and mark HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest appropriate SameSite and HttpOnly settings.

findings.summary: The load contacted 13 third-party origins and known trackers; 65 of 66 HAR requests were cross-origin relative to m.
findings.evidence: The load contacted 13 third-party origins and known trackers; 65 of 66 HAR requests were cross-origin relative to m.fmkorea.com and the consent dialog lists extensive personalised-ad processing.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors and fields, load analytics only after consent, batch events and proxy or self-host essential assets where practical.

findings.summary: No permission prompt fired on load, but the relevant login path offers password-only authentication and contains no WebAuthn/passkey integration.
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but the relevant login path offers password-only authentication and contains no WebAuthn/passkey integration.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys alongside recovery-safe fallback authentication and keep permission prompts tied to user actions.

findings.summary: CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are all absent; HSTS max-age is only 3600 seconds.
findings.evidence: CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are all absent; HSTS max-age is only 3600 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP with frame-ancestors, a long-lived HSTS policy after validation, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The personalised-ad consent wall blocks all content on a clean session and presents a lengthy vendor ecosystem before browsing can begin.
findings.evidence: The personalised-ad consent wall blocks all content on a clean session and presents a lengthy vendor ecosystem before browsing can begin.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the nagging wall with concise, honest choices, equal visual weight, no preselection and persistent rejection/withdrawal controls.

findings.summary: Login inputs are not marked required and duplicate login/search controls lack consistently associated labels, weakening native validation and accessible error routing.
findings.evidence: Login inputs are not marked required and duplicate login/search controls lack consistently associated labels, weakening native validation and accessible error routing.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required and autocomplete tokens, validate after interaction, connect field errors with aria-describedby and announce the error summary.

findings.summary: Both visible login implementations omit username/current-password autocomplete tokens, and search explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.evidence: Both visible login implementations omit username/current-password autocomplete tokens, and search explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply username and current-password autocomplete tokens and only disable autocomplete where there is a documented user benefit.

findings.summary: The audited login path provides password-only sign-in with no passkey/WebAuthn path; authenticated cancellation and account-management flows could not be entered without credentials.
findings.evidence: The audited login path provides password-only sign-in with no passkey/WebAuthn path; authenticated cancellation and account-management flows could not be entered without credentials.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey sign-in and reauthentication, and keep account and consent reversal routes obvious after authentication.

findings.summary: The homepage logo is delivered at 444px for a 111px display and 13 below-fold images lack native lazy loading; the article includes large 1200px images in a fixed-width layout.
findings.evidence: The homepage logo is delivered at 444px for a 111px display and 13 below-fold images lack native lazy loading; the article includes large 1200px images in a fixed-width layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive srcset/sizes variants, native lazy-load below-fold media and choose modern formats at display-appropriate resolution.

findings.summary: Advertising, analytics and consent scripts dominate the load before meaningful interaction, including about 355KB from AdSense and Tag Manager.
findings.evidence: Advertising, analytics and consent scripts dominate the load before meaningful interaction, including about 355KB from AdSense and Tag Manager.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and conditionally load nonessential third-party work after consent and when it can provide user value.

findings.summary: Third parties account for 65 requests and nearly the full 960KB transfer relative to the requested m.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 65 requests and nearly the full 960KB transfer relative to the requested m.fmkorea.com origin, with advertising and consent scripts the largest offenders.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, remove low-value vendors and lazy-load approved advertising after the core content.

taskList.title: Build a real mobile/reflow layout and restore visible focus/touch sizing
Make the consent experience non-blocking, semantic and honest
Repair labels, names, landmarks, heading order and contrast
Reduce and defer third-party advertising and analytics
Harden CSP, cookies and browser security policies
Reduce render-blocking CSS and improve LCP
Add passkeys and correct sign-in autocomplete/validation
Fix crawlability, sitemap and structured metadata
Optimise responsive images and lazy loading
Add system dark mode and progressive navigation transitions
